'''Malcolm's Dunes''' was the name of a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] settlement in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was led by a farmer named [[Hale Malcolm]].
